summary: The Utah Department of Natural Resources, through its Environmental Impact Evaluation Committee, supports ORV use on public lands but argues the draft EIS takes an overly negative tone and undervalues management, design, and planning as tools to mitigate environmental impacts. They contend the best alternative to the proposed action is the same action but with much greater emphasis on management, supervision, and planning than indicated in the Secretarial memorandum. They also request state review of all proposed regulations and guidelines given that over 75% of Utah is federal or state land.
